## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `e5c453170f24bc04e41d608b12cc8a24bed725b0`
Local-runs: none

PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12223 (card objectstack-ai/objectui#12190): 22 files, 273 additions / 205 deletions, three commits over merge-base `6c437b07` on `main`. Inputs read: the card body and its six comments (triage `6120128546`, claim `6121025853`, the cloud seat's ruling `6121921478`, the round-1 report `6122160275`, the amendment `6122200077`, the round-2 report `6122499354`), the PR body and file list, the net diff against `main`, and the 43 check-runs on the head, re-read at 2026-10-12T10:45Z: 40 `success`, 3 `skipped` (`Test (coverage)`, the coverage shard matrix, `dependabot`), none `in_progress`, none red. Governed surfaces: none of the 22 paths is one, and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` is `success`. Head repo is the base repo (not a fork); 478 changed lines.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept set of `EnvironmentListToolbar`'s `upgrade_for_development` branch** — RIGHT. The primary `environment-add-upgrade` button and the `useEffect` that called `onUpgrade(upgradeDialogSpec(...))` are gone. The branch renders `DevelopmentLockedMark` (outline, `Lock` icon, `environment.developmentLocked` filled from `planTier.teamAndUp`) only when `hasCreateAction` holds, so the #4123 one-list rule stands. This is the card's "Wanted" and the triage direction: an outline locked mark linking to `upgradeUrl`, no dialog.
- **Link resolution** — RIGHT. The mark reuses `resolveCtaHref` from `EnvironmentEntitlementDialog.tsx`: an absolute URL is linked verbatim and opens in a new tab with `rel="noopener noreferrer"`; a control-plane-relative path is prefixed with `VITE_SERVER_URL` when one is configured. With no `upgradeUrl` the mark is a non-interactive `span`, consistent with objectui#10437 (no URL composed in the console). Pinned in `EnvironmentListToolbar.test.tsx`: an `A` to `/settings/billing`, the absolute URL with `target=_blank`, a `SPAN` when absent, zh 「开发环境 · 团队版起」.
- **Deep link `?runAction=create_environment` in the locked state** — RIGHT, as directed. `useAutoRunCreate`'s predicate is unchanged (`requested === CREATE_ACTION && hasCreateAction && ctaKind != null`), so `useNavRunAction` still consumes the param (`history.replaceState` strips it) and nothing runs: no dialog, no `autoTrigger`. Pinned: `runAction` is `null` after mount, no `alertdialog`, no `action-bar`. The rationale (the intent is spent on the mark) is in the `useAutoRunCreate` docblock.
- **Structural no-dialog guarantee** — RIGHT. Round 2 removes the toolbar's `onUpgrade` prop and its `EntitlementDialogSpec` import, and the one `onUpgrade` attribute in `views/ObjectView.tsx`. The toolbar has no prop through which to ask for a dialog, and `Type Check` (`success`) refuses one. The reactive refusal dialog (`entitlementDialogFromError` through `useConsoleActionRuntime`'s api handler) is untouched, as the claim ordered.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell` published surface** — UNCHANGED, and declared right. `exports` is `.` and `./styles.css`; `src/index.ts` and its sub-barrels re-export nothing from `src/environment/` (the entry's only `environment` hit is a comment). `upgradeDialogSpec` (removed with its tests) and the `onUpgrade` prop were never reachable from the entry; `EntitlementDialogSpec` stays. `patch` for `@object-ui/app-shell` is right.
- **`@object-ui/i18n` published surface** — CHANGED IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. The dev's facts are right; the scoring is not (section ②). The packs are published (`exports` carries `./locales` and `./locales/*`) and `TranslationKeys` is `typeof en`, exported from the entry. All ten packs gain `planTier.teamAndUp` and `environment.developmentLocked` (a widening) and lose `environment.addEnvironment` (a narrowing: a consumer's `t('environment.addEnvironment')` now echoes the key, and the key leaves `TranslationKeys`). In-tree readers of the removed key outside the packs at the head: zero (the changeset is the only hit). The ten `planTier.teamAndUp` values match the ruled zh 「团队版起」.
- **Test id rename** `environment-add-upgrade` to `environment-development-locked` — not a published surface (no `exports` path), zero in-tree readers at the head, named in the changeset. Right.
- **Comment-only edits** in `EnvironmentEntitlementDialog.tsx`, `useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx`, `useEnvironmentEntitlements.ts`, `entitlements.ts` and `ObjectView.tsx` — no behaviour change; they stop describing the retired proactive dialog. Right.
- **Tests** — the removed `upgradeDialogSpec` pins (capitalised "Your", no URL means no CTA, the translator) stay covered through `entitlementDialogFromError` in the same files. The full suites the dev could not run locally ran on the head: `Test` and `Test (shard 1/8)` through `(8/8)` are all `success`.

### ② Semver level

- Declared: `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`, `'@object-ui/i18n': patch`; the PR body's line reads `Clause-②: yes` with no direction arm.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` `patch` — RIGHT: no export changes, internal removals only.
- `@object-ui/i18n` `patch` — WRONG. The diff changes what the package publishes: two keys added to the ten packs and to `TranslationKeys`, one key removed from both. The fleet's one reader of the `Clause-②` line (`scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs`, and the Post-Task Checklist rule it implements) states that `yes` takes at least `minor`; the removal is a narrowing of a published surface, which is breaking, and objectui's version policy (AGENTS.md §9 版本号策略) scores a breaking change `minor` with the breaking note in prose, never `major`. The changeset's "Why `patch`" paragraph cites practice (objectui#11591, #11659, #11717), not a rule; objectui has no CI gate for this mapping (`Changeset Bump Policy` only refuses `major`), so this record is the instrument. Required: `'@object-ui/i18n': minor`, with the body stating that `environment.addEnvironment` is removed (breaking for a consumer reading it; no replacement for the retired button; the locked state's text is `environment.developmentLocked`, its tier placeholder filled from `planTier.teamAndUp`). The fixed group of 40 moves to `minor` with it, which is the policy's intended effect.
- `Clause-②:` line — UNDER-DECLARED. The diff widens one surface and narrows another; the spelling that reads both facts is `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`. The arm is optional for a body written before it existed; this body is not one, and the narrowing is real. The triage's `Clause-②: no` was wrong for the same reason; the claim's `yes` was right as far as it went.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Round-1 `open_questions` (the dead `onUpgrade` prop and four stale comments) — ANSWERED by amendment `6122200077` (option A) and executed at `e5c45317`: verified in the diff (prop, import and the `ObjectView` attribute removed; the four comments rewritten; the `ManagedByBadge` region untouched).
- Round-2 `open_questions` — none declared.
- "Full `@object-ui/app-shell` suite NOT MEASURED locally" — ANSWERED by the head's check-runs: `Test` and all eight shards `success`.
- "`check:eager-locale-catalogues` NOT MEASURED locally" — ANSWERED by the head's check-runs: `Bundle Analysis` (the `performance-budget.yml` job that runs that script) is `success`, and its Console Performance Budget comment on the PR reads PASS (eager closure 3178.9 KB under the 3204.6 KB budget).
- "Not browser-checked" — declared, with the reason (no local control plane serves `/cloud/environment-entitlements`); the rendered DOM is pinned by the toolbar tests. Accepted as declared, not re-judged here.
- Clause-② discrepancy, triage `no` against claim `yes` — resolved in ②: `yes (narrowing)`.
- The cloud seat's instruction from the maintainer's session (`6121921478`: compose the tier label from the plan label rather than hard-coding 「团队版」) — ANSWERED with a measurement and not followed: the entitlement summary carries the org's current plan, not the tier development environments require, and the packs hold no per-plan label vocabulary, so composition is not possible from objectui alone; the tier-keyed `planTier.teamAndUp` keeps the reuse half. ESCALATED to the seat: composition needs a required-tier field on cloud's summary plus a plan-label vocabulary or cloud-supplied labels. The dev says the note is carried on objectui#12197 (on hold); #12197 is outside this review's inputs, so the seat confirms it is recorded there.
- Out-of-scope finding, carrier none: a paid org at its development capacity (`development.canCreate` false by limit, not by plan) lands in the same `upgrade_for_development` branch and now reads "Team plan and up" — ESCALATED. The conflation is pre-existing in `decideEnvironmentCta` (it used to open the "paid feature" dialog on click), but this PR turns it from a dialog on click into an always-visible statement that is false for a Team-plan org. Reach is unmeasured because cloud was unreadable from the dev session. This is a card for a seat with cloud access to confirm what the producer sends at capacity, not an acceptance note alone; it does not block this PR.
- Out-of-scope finding, carrier none: `ConsoleActionRuntime.openEntitlementDialog`, the returned member, now has no reader outside its hook. Not published from the entry; acceptable to leave for a card that next touches that file.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-12190-env-list-locked-mark`
Reviewed-by: `session_01G5TSaEwbEQsKMjhzTB4rEd`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

FAIL reasons: (1) `@object-ui/i18n` is declared `patch` while the diff removes a published pack key and adds two; `Clause-②: yes` takes at least `minor`, and a narrowing is breaking, so the changeset needs `'@object-ui/i18n': minor` with the breaking note and the removed-key mapping in its body. (2) The PR body's `Clause-②:` line omits the `(narrowing)` arm the diff requires. Both are edits to the changeset and the PR body on this branch; the code needs no change for this record. A new head takes a new record.
